title: Colours of Asia: Garden of Wonders
title_en: Colours of Asia: Garden of Wonders

desc_en: Runs 13-15 and 20-22 Nov. Free, no booking needed. Asian street food, lantern gardens, music, dance and artisan stalls.

desc_en: Runs 21-22 Nov. Free. 50+ Latin-owned stalls with Colombian, Brazilian, Mexican and Argentinian food, plus music and art.

title: Banksy Limitless
address: Melbourne Convention and Exhibition Centre, 1 Convention Centre Pl, South Wharf VIC 3006
desc: תערוכה עם יותר מ-250 יצירות והתקנות של בנקסי וחוויית הולוגרמה. מבוגר מ-$39, ילד מ-$28. תאריך הפתיחה לא חד-משמעתי במקורות (25.11 או כבר 11.11), כדאי לאמת באתר.
desc_en: An exhibition of 250+ Banksy works, installations and a hologram experience. Adult from $39, child from $28. Sources disagree on the opening date (25 Nov or already 11 Nov), so check the official site.

desc_en: 27 Nov-25 Dec, free. A 17.5 m LED Christmas tree with a light and sound show every hour in the evening. Tree lighting on 27 Nov at 6:30pm.
